_warning: Specs and ranking behavior change without notice. Verify anything load-bearing against current platform documentation. Ranking fields are inferred models, not published fact.

_fields.discovery: interest_graph | social_graph | following_feed | search | community | none
_fields.view_counted_at: the event that increments the platform's view counter
_fields.caveat: the way this platform's numbers mislead if taken at face value

youtube.caveat: 'Impressions' means thumbnail impressions, unlike every other platform. Shorts and long-form share a channel but not an algorithm.

tiktok.caveat: Views count at 0s and are not comparable to YouTube views. Never chart them on one axis.

instagram.caveat: Reach is unique accounts; impressions are repeated. Visible TikTok watermarks are demoted.

x.caveat: Impressions include scroll-past, so ER is structurally 5-10x lower than Instagram. Early velocity in the first 15-30 min largely decides reach.

facebook.organic_page_reach: very low; Groups and paid are the realistic surfaces
facebook.caveat: Daily reach is deduplicated per day. Summing daily reach over a month overcounts unique people substantially.

reddit.caveat: Vote counts are deliberately fuzzed by the platform; use rank order, not exact numbers. Subreddit rules are enforced by human moderators.

pinterest.caveat: Impressions accrue for months after publishing. Compare pins at equal age, never at a calendar cutoff.

threads.caveat: Views are comparable to X impressions, not to Instagram reach.

snapchat.caveat: Story metrics expire; exports cover only the retention window. Spotlight is the only real organic discovery surface.

twitch.caveat: Average concurrent viewers matters, not total views. Discovery is genuinely weak; off-platform clips feed it.

discord.caveat: No impression denominator exists. Do not compute an engagement rate. Retention surface, not acquisition.

telegram.caveat: Channel view counts are cumulative and permanent. Difference them before charting or every day reads as a spike.

whatsapp.caveat: Largest messaging platform globally; dominant in India, Brazil, Indonesia, Nigeria. Channel metrics limited to views and reactions. Business messaging is template-gated and paid.

bluesky.caveat: Chronological plus custom feeds; no central algorithm. No native analytics export.

douyin.caveat: Separate app and algorithm from TikTok. Live commerce is the dominant format. Requires domestic entity registration for commercial accounts.

xiaohongshu.caveat: Behaves more like a search engine with a social layer. Dominant for beauty, lifestyle, and travel purchase decisions.

wechat.caveat: Closed ecosystem with almost no public discovery. Distribution is sharing into private networks.

weibo.caveat: Public broadcast, celebrity and news driven.

kuaishou.caveat: Stronger in lower-tier cities; more community-oriented than Douyin.
